# Japanese Names

> Japanese Names is an English-language reference and generation website for Japanese personal names. It provides database-backed Japanese full-name, given-name, and surname tools with kanji, kana readings, romaji, meaning notes, and evidence-aware explanations.

Japanese Names uses stored spelling-and-reading records rather than inventing arbitrary kanji combinations. The generators select names from the local dataset without generative AI or external name-generation services. All names, readings, written forms, and displayed meanings come from the site's structured records.

Important interpretation notes:

- Japanese name order normally places the family name before the given name.
- A given-name meaning belongs to a particular kanji spelling; the same reading may have multiple written forms and meanings.
- Kanji glosses explain character components and do not prove a name bearer's intended meaning.
- A surname's literal kanji meaning does not prove one geographic origin, lineage, or shared ancestry.
- Detail pages are published for roughly 500 records (about 278 given-name readings and 220 surnames) that pass the site's verification and data-sufficiency checks; each cites its sources.
- Generated full-name pairings can be plausible without being common or belonging to a known person. Important real-world naming decisions should be reviewed by a fluent Japanese speaker or qualified naming professional.

## Core tools

- [Japanese Name Generator](https://japanesenames.site/): Generate complete male, female, or unisex Japanese names from stored surname and given-name records, with kanji, kana, romaji, meanings, filters, and Japanese or Western name order.
- [Japanese Last Name Generator](https://japanesenames.site/japanese-last-name-generator): Generate one stored Japanese surname at a time and view its kanji, kana, romaji, literal meaning, and available commonness or origin labels.

## Guides and articles

- [All guides](https://japanesenames.site/articles): Long-form Japanese-name guides grouped by popularity, meaning themes, name lists, and naming culture.
- [How Japanese Names Work](https://japanesenames.site/articles/how-japanese-names-work): Surname-first order, legal kanji lists, unregulated readings, gendered endings, and marriage-name rules.
- [Most Popular Japanese Names](https://japanesenames.site/articles/most-popular-japanese-names): The readings topping recent newborn surveys (Haruto, Ao, Himari, Rin), with kanji and meanings.
- [100 Most Common Japanese Surnames](https://japanesenames.site/articles/most-common-japanese-surnames): The top 100 family names in order with landscape meanings.
- [Japanese Names Meaning Moon](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-meaning-moon), [Light](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-meaning-light), [Flower](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-meaning-flower), [Snow](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-meaning-snow), and [Love](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-meaning-love): Names grouped by the imagery their kanji carries.
- [Unisex Japanese Names](https://japanesenames.site/articles/unisex-japanese-names): Names that register for both genders, with each name's gender lean.
- [Japanese Anime Names](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-anime-names): Which anime character names are real, registerable names and which are fiction.
- [Japanese Names That Work in English](https://japanesenames.site/articles/japanese-names-that-work-in-english): Bilingual-friendly names and pronunciation notes.
- [Cool Japanese Last Names](https://japanesenames.site/articles/cool-japanese-last-names): Dark, rare, and dramatic surnames, plus the fictional ones to recognize.

## Browse and research

- [Japanese Girl Names](https://japanesenames.site/japanese-girl-names): Browse Japanese girl-name readings and kanji spellings with meaning, style, commonness, and written-length filters.
- [Japanese Boy Names](https://japanesenames.site/japanese-boy-names): Browse Japanese boy-name readings and kanji spellings with meaning, style, commonness, and written-length filters.
- [Japanese Last Names and Surnames](https://japanesenames.site/japanese-last-names): Browse Japanese family names with kanji, kana, romaji, literal meanings, origin classifications, and evidence labels.
- [Data method and sources](https://japanesenames.site/about): Explains how the site uses JMnedict spelling-and-reading records, KANJIDIC2 character glosses, editorial review, confidence labels, and source-aware publishing rules.
